verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents prebuilt, source-available triggers and actions for thousands of apps, with one-click OAuth for 3,000+ APIs, 10,000+ tools, and a probe listing 3,223 apps in its marketplace. Community users confirm the prebuilt integration steps saved them work, for example an Airtable-to-Algolia build. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the integrations are vendor-maintained (components are partly community-contributed via GitHub PRs), and independent evidence on integration quality or upkeep across the catalog.
